title: Data Collectors (VaxConnect)
description: About Techally Techally Consult PLC is an Ethiopian technology and health systems consulting company committed to developing innovative digital solutions that strengthen health service delivery and health information systems. Through collaboration with government, research institutions, and development partners, Techally designs and evaluates digital health innovations that improve efficiency, data quality, and health outcomes. Techally is implementing the VaxConnect Project, an implementation research initiative evaluating VaxConnect — a digital platform designed to integrate routine immunization service delivery with vaccine supply chain management in selected woredas of Ethiopia. The project aims to generate evidence on the feasibility, acceptability, usability, and effectiveness of VaxConnect in improving immunization programme performance, vaccine management, caregiver engagement, and data-driven decision-making. About This Role To support the baseline assessment, Techally Consult PLC is seeking qualified and motivated Data Collectors to conduct facility assessments, extract routine immunization performance data, and collect qualitative information from health workers and programme managers. Data collectors will work under the supervision of project leads, field supervisors, and the coordinator at Armauer Hansen Research Institute. Study sites include Zikuala and Sekota Zuria woredas in Amhara Region, and Aysaita and Adaar woredas in Afar Region. What you'll do Conduct health facility assessments using the Facility Assessment and Immunization Service Observation Tool Observe routine immunization service delivery and document service readiness and workflow Extract routine immunization programme indicators from health facility records, immunization registers, tally sheets, stock records, and DHIS2 reports using the Routine Immunization Performance Indicator Extraction Tool Verify completeness and consistency of extracted data across multiple data sources Ensure all required quantitative data are accurately recorded using REDCap Conduct Key Informant Interviews (KIIs) with health workers, facility managers, immunization focal persons, woreda health office staff, and other stakeholders using project qualitative tools Facilitate interviews professionally while maintaining neutrality and confidentiality; take comprehensive field notes and support audio recording following informed consent procedures Translate and transcribe qualitative interviews where required Review completed questionnaires daily for completeness and consistency; resolve data discrepancies with respondents before leaving study sites Upload completed electronic (REDCap) data to server and report field challenges promptly to supervisors Participate in daily debriefing meetings, project training, and pilot testing of data collection tools Obtain informed consent from all study participants and adhere to approved research protocols and ethical guidelines Travel to assigned health facilities according to the fieldwork schedule and perform other project-related duties as assigned What we're looking for Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Nursing, Health Officer, Health Informatics, Epidemiology, or another relevant health-related field (MPH/MSc is an added advantage) At least two years of experience in health research or public health surveys Demonstrated experience in quantitative and qualitative data collection Experience conducting health facility assessments or programme evaluations is desirable Experience extracting routine health information from facility registers, DHIS2, or HMIS records Experience using electronic data collection platforms such as KoboToolbox, ODK, SurveyCTO, REDCap, or CommCare is an advantage Previous experience working on immunization, maternal and child health, digital health, or implementation research projects is highly desirable Technical skills REDCap or similar electronic data capture platforms KoboToolbox, ODK, SurveyCTO, or CommCare DHIS2 and HMIS data extraction Health facility assessments and programme evaluations Key Informant Interview facilitation and transcription Routine immunization programme indicators and registers Personal qualities Excellent interviewing and communication skills Strong organizational and time management skills Ability to work independently under minimal supervision High attention to detail and commitment to data quality Ability to travel extensively and work in rural and pastoral settings Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism Good written and spoken English Fluency in Amharic is required Proficiency in the Afar language is highly desirable for assignments in the Afar Region. title: HR and Admin Assistant
description: Work With Us HR and Admin Assistant Apply Now Danish Refugee Council, one of the world’s leading humanitarian NGOs, is currently looking for a qualified HR and Admin Assistant for our operations in Debarke/Debat, Ethiopia. Instruction For Applicants All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English. Please ensure that your CV does not exceed three pages. Applications with CVs longer than the specified limit may not be considered Overall purpose of the role The HR and Admin Assistant is responsible for the efficient management of the HR, Admin and premises/warehouse functions at the field level. S/he ensures compliance with DRC’s policies and procedures and supports SS Team Leader in strengthening internal controls and accountability. Human Resources Your main duties and responsibilities will be: Assist in ensuring staff compliance with human resources polices, as per DRC’s Operations Handbook and local HR Handbook. Ensure that leave, recruitment and training trackers are updated on a regular basis. Monitor staff attendance and ensure that all staff timesheets are submitted and filed on time. Assist in communicating with interview candidates and scheduling for tests and interviews. Prepare employee contracts. Responsible for ensuring the following are accurate, complete and up to date: -personnel files, administration of health insurance scheme, social security, Assist managers and staff on effective performance management and administer the collation of performance management documentation Ensure new staff receive an appropriate orientation and induction. Support staff development activities including promoting the DRC Learning Catalogue. Ensure clearance and debriefing is carried out for exiting staff. Administration Ensure that all office systems and equipment (power, water, telephone, photocopier, fax, etc.) are in good working order. Payment of office and guest house bills. Responsible for office supplies. Responsible for necessary repairs & maintenance in a timely manner in coordination with the Logistics staff. Manage all contract arrangements with lessors and ensuring that contractual obligations are adhered to. Establish central mail recording system and filing system. Ensure that DRC staff have Identification cards (ID) with the period of validity in accordance with the employment contract. Warehouse/Premises Support Work closely with the Supply Chain team to support stock receipt, recordkeeping, and proper storage where necessary. Support the Area Manager in conducting periodic checks of premises and supplies (e.g., fire extinguishers, fuel stock). Ensure inventory forms and casual contracts (cleaners, cooks, etc.) are documented and archived Procurement To manage all procurement activities at the emergency office (P2P) goods, service, work within the approved threshold. Implement the procurement plans. Experience And Technical Competencies Minimum 1 year's relevant work experience in similar field. Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., DYN) and high proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel). Solid understanding of Ethiopian labor law and administrative procedures. Experience with HR practices, staff coordination, and logistics is desirable. Strong organizational and interpersonal skills; ability to multitask under pressure. EDUCATION: (include certificates, licenses, etc.) Diploma in HR Management, Business Administration or equivalent professional qualification LANGUAGE: (indicate Fluency level) Advanced spoken and written English Proficiency in (Amharic) preferred. In this position, you are expected to demonstrate DRC’ five core competencies: Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. We offer Contract length: 12 Months Contract Type: National Contract Band: I2 – Non-Management Designation of Duty Station: Debark/Dabat, Ethiopia Start date: 15th August 2026 Salary and conditions will be in accordance with Danish Refugee Council’s Terms of Employment for National employees Application process All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV (no longer than three pages) in English. title: Assistant Project Manager
description: Search by keyword Show more options Loading... Job Category Section All Contract Type All Job Location All Salary/Hourly rate All Clear Select How Often (in Days) To Receive An Alert Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Apply now » Assistant Project Manager Date: 16 Jul 2026 Job Location: Gloucestershire This is a Gloucestershire County Council job. Job Title: Assistant Project Manager Job Location: Shire Hall, Block 5, 6th Floor Salary: £33,143 - £40,777 per annum Hours per Week: 37.00 Contract Type: Permanent Closing Date: 09/08/2026 Job Requisition Number: 14533 This post is not open to job share Do you want to play a key role in shaping highways to save lives and encourage greater sustainable travel? The post of Assistant Project Manager gives you an opportunity to do just that. You will support the management of projects with the aim of significantly reducing the number of serious and fatally injured people and providing greater infrastructure for walking and cycling enhancing quality of life. You will have a keen interest in and a commitment to road safety and sustainability. In this role, you will assist with the project management of traffic engineering projects through their life cycle. You will work with inhouse and external teams to deliver design solutions and construction phases to provide outcomes that achieve project and council objectives. About The Team & Role You will support Project Managers with the control of projects and play a key role in their programme, risk, and budget management. You will build and maintain excellent working relationships with internal and external stakeholders. You will work with colleagues to bid for funding. You will ensure that projects follow required policies and processes. You will ensure that health and safety regulations are applied to all projects including the CDM Regulations 2015. This position offers a career progression pathway opportunity that allows you to increase your knowledge, skills and responsibilities to achieve the requirements of the higher grade. To see further why developing your career with Gloucestershire County Council can be hugely rewarding please see the link below. https://www.gloucestershire.gov.uk/recruitment/highways-recruitment/ About You You will have experience in highway and traffic engineering design and of supporting the project management of highway and traffic engineering projects. You will be experienced in producing and managing programmes and have a track record of effective stakeholder collaboration. You will be work under pressure to meet deadlines. You will have experience of applying the CDM Regulations 2015. You will understand sustainable travel principles and the impact of engineering on environmental issues. You will be committed to health, safety, welfare, and equal opportunities. About Us Hybrid working arrangements are available for many of our roles, giving teams the opportunity to work in a way that suits them, balancing service need and individual choice, with a mix of both remote and office working. For all your hard work, you will receive the following: Flexible and agile working opportunities 25.5 days annual leave rising to 30.5 days after 5 years continuous service An option to purchase 10 days of additional leave per year (pro rata for part-time staff) Family friendly employer offering benefits to help support you and your family Career development and qualification opportunities Supportive and positive working environment with regular, robust supervision Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) that provides free, confidential, counselling and advice for employees, available 24 hours a day, online and by telephone. An in-house Occupational Health service Employee discount scheme Cycle to Work scheme Gloucestershire Salary Sacrifice Green Car Scheme (T&Cs apply) Links to employee networks such as Prism (LGBT+) network and the Young Employees Network How To Apply If you feel you have the skills, desire and experience required to make a positive difference then please submit your application and personal statement today by clicking the “Apply Now” Button. For An Informal Discussion About The Role Please Contact Craig Schofield, Traffic Engineering Manager, via email at craig.schofield@gloucestershire.gov.uk or Katie Midgley, Programme Manager, via email at katie.midgley@gloucestershire.gov.uk Applicants will be shortlisted and interviewed during the advertisement period. As such the closing date may be altered subject to candidates being successful. Short-listed candidates will be contacted by e-mail. title: Finance and Admin Assistant
description: Work With Us Finance and Admin Assistant Apply Now Danish Refugee Council, one of the world’s leading humanitarian NGOs, is currently looking for a qualified Finance and Admin Assistance for our operations in Humera, Ethiopia. Instruction For Applicants All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English. Please ensure that your CV does not exceed three pages. Applications with CVs longer than the specified limit may not be considered Overall purpose of the role Under the supervision of the Support Service Team Leader, the Finance Assistant provides financial and administrative support to DRC operations and partners in accordance with DRC financial procedures, donor regulations, and national legislation. The role ensures accurate financial recordkeeping, cash management, payment processing, reporting, and compliance while supporting efficient finance operations. Your Main Duties And Responsibilities Will Be Finance and Accounting Perform daily bookkeeping in accordance with the DRC Finance Handbook. Record financial transactions accurately in DRC Dynamics. Ensure transactions are posted to the correct project, budget line, and ledger accounts. Prepare payment vouchers, receipt vouchers, journal vouchers, and supporting documentation. Verify that all payments are supported by complete and approved documentation before processing. Maintain proper filing (electronic and physical) of financial records, including vouchers, contracts, tender documents, bank documents, and supporting schedules. Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities. Maintain routine financial records and follow established work plans. Cash and Bank Management Manage petty cash according to DRC financial procedures. Process petty cash replenishments. Conduct daily and monthly cash counts and prepare cash count reports. Safeguard cash held in the office safe. Handle cash receipts and cash disbursements. Manage cash advances and ensure timely settlement in accordance with DRC policies. Process approved bank transfers and maintain proper documentation. Liaise with banks on routine banking activities. Monitor cash balances and support cash flow management. Payment Processing Process approved payments accurately and on time. Ensure supplier, staff, statutory, and partner payments comply with DRC procedures. Support salary payment processing where applicable. Assist in remitting taxes, pension, and other statutory obligations. Ensure timely payment of operational expenses such as utilities when applicable. Reporting Prepare monthly cash count reports. Support preparation of financial reports. Assist in collecting, reviewing, correcting, and filing partners' financial reports. Submit assigned financial progress and status reports. Support reconciliation of cash, bank, and ledger balances. Compliance and Documentation Ensure compliance with DRC financial policies, donor regulations, and local legislation. Maintain complete audit trials for all financial transactions. Ensure supporting documents are properly archived and readily available for audits. Follow internal controls and safeguard organizational assets. Administrative Support Assist finance staff with daily operational activities. Follow assigned work plans and priorities. Provide backup support to other finance team members during absences as assigned. Perform other duties assigned by the line manager. Experience And Technical Competencies Minimum 1–2 years of relevant finance or accounting experience. Previous NGO or humanitarian organization experience is an advantage. Experience in bookkeeping, cash management, and payment processing. Experience using ERP systems (preferably Microsoft Dynamics). Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint. Strong organizational and planning skills. Good analytical and numerical skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multicultural environment. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to meet deadlines while maintaining accuracy. EDUCATION: (include certificates, licenses, etc.) BA Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Management or other directly related field from University or higher education LANGUAGE: (indicate Fluency level) Excellent skills in speaking, reading and writing English. title: Manufacturing and Production Work
description: Types of Accidents and Injuries You Might Suffer Factory Jobs Often Involve Tough, Repetitive Work And Exposure To Serious Hazards. Some Of The Most Common Causes Of Injury Include Repetitive Motion : Tasks done over and over can cause you carpal tunnel, tendonitis, bursitis, and other painful soft tissue injuries. Overexertion: Repeated heavy lifting and physically demanding work can lead to muscle and bone problems. Body Movement Strain: Constant crawling, twisting, reaching, and bending can wear down your body over time. Forklift accidents: These machines are essential, but you can be seriously hurt if pinned or caught in the equipment. Harmful Substances: Being exposed to chemicals and toxins can cause burns, lung problems, or other long-term illnesses. Equipment & Objects: Heavy machinery can crush, cut, or even lead to amputations in the event of an accident. Fires & Explosions: Flammable materials can quickly turn a small fire into a deadly blaze. Because of these risks, you face injuries such as amputations, broken bones, spinal cord damage, burns, toxic exposure illnesses, respiratory problems, hearing or vision loss, and more on your job. Some injuries may heal with time and treatment, while others can cause permanent disability. title: Corporate English Trainer
description: About GoFLUENT For over 20 years, goFLUENT has helped organizations worldwide develop language and communication skills through innovative learning solutions that combine technology, engaging content, and live instruction. Today, more than 1,000 international companies across 100+ countries trust goFLUENT to help their employees communicate confidently, collaborate globally, and succeed in an increasingly connected workplace. Join our global team as a Corporate English Trainer and help business professionals from diverse industries build the communication skills they need to thrive in their careers. Empower Global Professionals Through Language Deliver engaging online lessons to professionals from leading companies around the world. Every day brings a new opportunity; you could be teaching executives, managers, engineers, doctors, lawyers, scientists, or other industry experts who rely on strong communication skills to succeed in today's global workplace. What You'll Do Deliver live online language lessons to business professionals in one-on-one and small-group settings. Facilitate engaging lessons using our established and proven teaching methodology. Create an interactive and supportive virtual learning environment that encourages learner participation. Please note that the anticipated teaching start date for this position is September. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree or equivalent Experience in language teaching or corporate training is preferred Excellent spoken and written English Comfortable teaching through video conferencing platforms Strong communication and presentation skills Professional, engaging, and learner-focused Quiet workspace with a reliable internet connection Why Join Us? Teach professionals from leading global organizations Work remotely with a flexible schedule Join a diverse, international team Build your teaching and corporate training experience Make a meaningful impact on learners' professional growth This Role Is a Great Fit If You Love the flexibility of a 30-hour workweek (weekends optional) Prefer a daytime teaching schedule Want the convenience of a fully remote and freelance position Technical & Operational Requirements Dedicated, stable workspace for remote work PC or Laptop: Windows 10 or up or Mac (Monterey/Ventura/Sonoma) Intel Processor: Core i5 12th gen / i7 11th gen (or equivalent) and up Mac processor: Macbook Pro - M1 Chip or Macbook Air - M1 Chip 8 GB RAM and up 20 GB of free disk space High-speed Internet connection (Download 10 Mbps, Upload 10 Mbps)

title: epoxy
description: Company Description Annoushka Jewellery is a contemporary jewelry brand recognized for its distinctive designs and meticulous craftsmanship. The company focuses on creating pieces that combine artistic expression with high-quality materials, appealing to clients who value originality and attention to detail. Team members work in a creative, fast-paced environment where precision and reliability are essential. Annoushka Jewellery encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and pride in producing exceptional products. Joining the team offers the opportunity to contribute directly to the creation of unique jewelry pieces and to grow within a specialized craft. Role Description The epoxy role at Annoushka Jewellery is a full-time, on-site position based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. This role involves preparing and mixing epoxy resins according to specific formulas and quality standards, and applying epoxy to jewelry components to ensure a durable, polished finish. Day-to-day tasks include measuring materials accurately, monitoring curing times, checking for defects or imperfections, and making necessary adjustments to maintain consistency and quality. The role also includes cleaning and maintaining workstations and tools, following safety procedures, and collaborating with designers and production staff to meet order deadlines. The person in this role will be expected to follow detailed instructions, maintain high attention to detail, and support continuous improvements in the finishing process. Qualifications Ability to work with epoxy and similar materials, including accurate measuring, mixing, and application for small, detailed items. Strong attention to detail and quality control, with the ability to identify imperfections and ensure a consistent, high-quality finish. Basic understanding of safe handling of chemicals and adherence to workplace health and safety guidelines. Good hand–eye coordination and manual dexterity for fine, detailed work in jewelry production. Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with production and design teams. Reliability and time management skills to meet production schedules and deadlines. Prior experience in jewelry making, resin art, crafts, or similar precision manufacturing is an advantage. Willingness to learn specialized techniques and follow structured processes and quality standards.

title: MEAL Officer
description: JOB DESCRIPTION The Opportunity The MEAL Officer will be responsible for monitoring project activities, including conducting post-distribution monitoring and supporting project assessments in close collaboration with data collectors. The role also involves supporting external evaluation processes, ensuring the effective implementation of accountability systems in project intervention areas, and capturing learning insights for the field office under the Strengthening Climate Resilience through the Integrated Landscape Project , in close coordination with the project field team The MEAL Officer will be responsible for collecting essential performance monitoring data, conducting quality benchmark monitoring, and preparing monthly accomplishment reports for submission to the MEAL Coordinator. Furthermore, he/she will support and facilitate MEAL-related tasks in collaboration with the MEAL team to ensure the timely delivery of activities with the desired quality standard. KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY: (MEAL officer) Job Specific Roles And Responsibilities Finalize and operationalize the MEAL Plan, IPTT, SOPs, aligning indicators with PMF/logical frameworks of the project Finalize and operationalize other MEAL toolkits, such as MEAL PIRS, Action Tracker, Feedback Tracker, and Quality Benchmarks Develop and update MEAL plan and log frame on PRIME, ensuring indicator progress and means of verification are adequately updated by project teams. Lead set-up of database design, digital data collection (Kobo), data management pipelines, and Power BI dashboards for near real-time performance monitoring. Establish Data Quality Assurance (DQA) procedures and verification sampling frames Reporting Oversee routine monitoring cycles, ensuring completeness, timeliness, and disaggregation (gender, age, inclusion, and participation of women, youth, children, and persons with disabilities in project‑relevant activities and decision‑making. Design and implement DQAs, spot checks, back-checks, and collect the relevant beneficiaries' data from project livelihood officers. Supervise the project progress with a standard checklist in project intervention kebeles and triangulate among their monthly progress reports, then identify data quality gaps. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Minimum Qualifications and Experience Required Essential: BA/BSC Degree in Monitoring & Evaluation, Statistics, Agriculture, Livelihoods, Rural Development, Economics, advanced degree preferred. 3 years MEAL experience in livelihoods, economic empowerment or market systems programs, with at least 2 years directly to FSL projects. Strong practical experience with digital data collection tools (Kobo/ODK), data management systems, and dashboarding tools. KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITY Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in difficult environments Experience in pastoral contexts, preferably Afar region; knowledge of the Afar language mandatory Excellent report writing and English proficiency. Strong interpersonal, advocacy, communication, and facilitation skills The Organisation We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday All children learn from a quality basic education and that, Violence against children is no longer tolerated We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive environment where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.
